# Limitations {#sec-limitations}

QViz is a teaching tool. These are the limits that come from that goal and from
the platforms it runs on.

- **At most 16 qubits.** The exact statevector grows as `2ⁿ`.
- **IonQ and the built-in simulator only.** IBM, AWS and any other backend are
  rejected with an explicit error.
- **The noise is didactic.** It is a simple error model, not a calibrated one.
  No circuit is sent to real hardware: the viewer uses the native-gate sequence
  and the profiles of the machine.
- **The viewer needs WebGL.** Under Qollab, the `three/addons/` imports and the
  speed with 16 qubits depend on the platform.
- **Qollab has limits.** It does not serve the other files of a project, it
  accepts at most 100 files and 2 MB per file, and an IonQ backend allows one
  job per run. The details and the workarounds are in
  [the Qollab page](../frontend/qollab.qmd).
- **The Bloch vectors can shrink or vanish.** This is expected while a qubit is
  entangled (`r < 1`), and it can happen in the middle of a two-qubit gate even
  when the circuit has no entanglement at the end.
- **Tomography on a non-IonQ backend** needs `qiskit-ionq` 1.0.3 or later. It is
  outside the delivery and is not connected to the viewer.
